chunks: Al-Bazofari from Humayd ibn al-Ziyad, from al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Zayan, from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who had two sister-slaves with him, and he had intercourse with one of them, then it pleased him to have intercourse with the other. He said: 'He should abstain from this one and have intercourse with the other.'
I said: 'But his desire is aroused for the first one.' He said: 'He should not approach her until he frees that one from his ownership.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a man who owns two sister-slaves and wants to have intercourse with both?
ai.summary: In this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), the condition for lawful intercourse with the second sister-slave is the emancipation of the first, addressing the juristic debate on whether simultaneous ownership permits concurrent relations. This specific requirement highlights the Shia emphasis on removing the 'bond of ownership' to ensure distinct legal status, distinguishing it from the general permissibility of owning up to four wives or two sister-slaves under certain conditions. It underscores the practical implication that desire for one does not invalidate the right to the other, provided the first is freed, thereby clarifying the mechanics of polygamy in the slave context.
